name.en: Standing-seam roof clamps (S-5! family and ClickFit EVO seam clamp) with rails
name.es: Garras para cubierta de junta alzada (familia S-5! y garra de junta ClickFit EVO) con rieles

description.en: Clamps grip the raised seam of a standing-seam metal roof without penetrating the roof panel. A set screw (self-drilling or hex flange bolt) tightens the clamp onto the seam. Rails (or direct module clamps) are bolted to the clamps. Reference families: S-5! clamps (S-5-U, S-5-S, S-5-E, S-5-B, S-5-V and Mini variants, S-5-H90) and Enstall ClickFit EVO seam clamp.
description.es: Las garras abrazan la junta alzada de la cubierta metálica sin perforar el panel. Un tornillo de apriete (autoperforante o tornillo de brida hexagonal) fija la garra a la junta. Los rieles, o las garras de módulo directas, se atornillan a las garras. Familias de referencia: garras S-5! (S-5-U, S-5-S, S-5-E, S-5-B, S-5-V y variantes Mini, S-5-H90) y garra de junta ClickFit EVO de Enstall.

grounding_bonding: Bonding hardware for S-5 and ClickFit EVO was not stated in the sources reviewed. Bonding method, conductor size and whether the clamp itself bonds the seam must be obtained from the manufacturer and the local standard.
installation_notes: S-5 installation guide: torque values are for the setscrew; the range depends on metal and gauge (22 ga steel 18 to 20 Nm; other metals and thinner steel 15 to 17 Nm; M8 hex flange bolt for critical applications 13 ft-lb).
S-5 compatible seam types include standing seam, machine-folded seam, snap-together seam and vertical double-fold (with lip engagement for S-5-U, S-5-V, U Mini and V Mini).
ClickFit EVO accepts single-folded, snap, double-folded and round standing seams; copper roofs excluded (manufacturer).
ClickFit EVO seam opening sizes listed as 14 mm, 9 mm and round 23 mm diameter; mapping to clamp articles not stated.
Seam clamp pull-out capacity and slip resistance are not in the sources and must come from the roof-panel manufacturer or a test report.

Bolt grade of the M8 hex flange bolt (not stated).
Bonding and grounding for S-5 clamps (no statement in S-5 guide; not found for ClickFit).
Torque values are in-lb in the S-5 guide; Nm values are converted (x 0.11298) and kept as ranges in the notes.
